workflows.name: Speed Estimation
workflows.description: Local YOLO → ByteTracker → Velocity → BBox/Label viz. Estimates per-track speed in m/s from pixels_per_meter.

workflows.name: Smart Camera (Time-in-Zone)
workflows.description: Local YOLO → ByteTracker → TimeInZone → Zone+BBox+Label viz. Tracks dwell time inside a polygon zone.

workflows.name: Auto-Annotate (YOLO-World)
workflows.description: Open-vocabulary detection from text prompts using YOLO-World + BBox/Label viz. No tracking.

workflows.name: Auto-Annotate (SAM3)
workflows.description: Same shape as YOLO-World autoannotate but uses Meta SAM3 for segmentation-grade bboxes. Requires `sam3` package.

workflows.name: VLM Class Suggester
workflows.description: Single OpenAI-compatible block. Sends a sample image to gemini-flash-lite, asks for a class list as JSON.
